use: Reuse matched group/count/dtype/phase costs to price moving, removing or changing collective placement.
Compare per-rank distributions; retain readiness and contention. No sum across ranks and no pooling with historical eager profiles.
New measurement needs a named high-value decision that changes over the unknown range. Reuse this actual count set when batching relevant calibration.
MC2/DispatchFFNCombine internal traffic is not represented by these standalone TP8 collectives.
correction: dataType integer is decoded against installed HcclDataType. STRING_IDS lookup at that integer is unrelated and deliberately ignored.
limits: Envelope and native durations include readiness/wait; neither is transfer-only latency.
Reported count bytes are not link traffic, algorithm byte volume, or proof of useful payload. No bandwidth was derived.
Profile group labels and coarse algorithm labels are not physical topology or full transport attestation.
Outside-target phase may include draft/preparation; unknown native bindings are preserved. Repeated shapes do not prove the same tensor or role.
No new model run or NPU benchmark. Empirical communication curves and physical rates remain unmeasured.
